response.rationale: The item is final_sale == True (intimates), which triggers RET-012 (priority 100), the highest-priority applicable rule. Although the return is within the standard 30-day window, RET-007 requires final_sale == False and does not apply. The defective exception (RET-020) also does not apply since defective is null/not True. Final-sale status dominates, making the return ineligible.
